prompts.name: brief
prompts.description: Brief a workspace: what its knowledge says now, what is contested, what is weakly supported, and what is waiting on your decision - written from current state, never stored.

arguments.name: workspace
arguments.description: Workspace to brief. Omitted: the node default. '*' for all.

arguments.name: focus
arguments.description: Optional topic to center the brief on.

prompts.name: what-do-we-know-about
prompts.description: What the store holds on one topic, with sources - and what it does not hold.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: The topic, as you would search for it.

arguments.name: workspace
arguments.description: Workspace to search. Omitted: every workspace.

prompts.name: curate
prompts.description: Improve the canon: draft proposals for the tidy-ups the curation signals point at, for you to review in the console. Nothing is decided by the model.

arguments.name: workspace
arguments.description: Workspace to curate. Omitted: the node default. '*' for all.

prompts.name: review-proposal
prompts.description: A first-pass review of one proposal: what merging it would change in belief, what its checks say, and a recommendation. The verdict stays yours.
